Name: Verify Unable to Unassign Location message displays during active pick shift
Objective: Verify that the system displays the correct UI message when attempting to unassign a location for an item in an active pick shift
Pre-condition:
1. Item exists in system
2. Location is assigned to item
3. Pick shift is active for the item
